class.name: SignalHeadNode
class.brief_description: A node proxy of one signal head: its kind, aspect and lights, read from and written to [SignallingServer].
class.description: One signal head of [SignallingServer], driven freely - no state machine. With a [member model] set, the node registers that model's lights as the signal head itself; without one, it attaches to the signal head already registered under its name (a scenery's). The properties are proxies of the signal head on the server: they read and change it there, so a change made by a system shows here as well. Only the kind and the aspect a registered signal head starts with are kept on the node, for the scene to set. A signal head that belongs to a system is still changed from here, and the system overwrites it with its next event.
